headerDisplay: The **Homebridge FirstAlert** plugin allows you to control FirstAlert thermostats and also view your Leak Sensors from HomeKit. To get started link your FirstAlert account using the button below.
footerDisplay:
Your FirstAlert account has been linked. Please raise any issues on our [project page](https://github.com/homebridge-plugins/homebridge-FirstAlert/issues).

If you would like to have other FirstAlert Devices besides Thermostat, or Leak Sensors added to this plugin fill out [Feature Request Form](https://github.com/homebridge-plugins/homebridge-FirstAlert/issues/new?assignees=&labels=&template=feature_request.md).

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for FirstAlert API. Use the button below to log in and obtain this token.

pollInterval.description: How often to poll device state (5-3600 seconds).
